Brand Introduction

Nuud Pleasures is a Miami-based wellness brand on a mission to redefine self-care and connection through thoughtfully crafted products. We focus on empowering confidence, fostering intimacy, and embracing individuality. By blending high-quality ingredients with innovative designs, we create experiences that enhance your well-being and spark joy in every moment.

Product Description

Our product line is designed to bring balance, pleasure, and relaxation to everyday life. From indulgent, delicious edibles to soothing wellness products, every item is made with care and precision. Each product is crafted using premium, natural ingredients to ensure safety, quality, and satisfaction.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

  1. Innovative Formulations: High-quality, clean ingredients combined with cutting-edge product design.
  2. Inclusivity: Products for all individuals, promoting a safe space to explore wellness and confidence.
  3. Miami Spirit: Vibrant, bold branding that embodies the energy and culture of Miami.
  4. Sustainability: Commitment to eco-conscious packaging and ethically sourced ingredients.

Payment Terms

  • Payment Options: We accept all major credit cards, bank transfers, and secure online payment systems (e.g., PayPal, Stripe).
  • Wholesale Terms: For bulk purchases, a minimum order quantity applies with a 50% deposit upfront and the balance upon delivery.
  • Refund Policy: Returns are accepted within 30 days for unused and unopened products.

Other Information

  • Shipping: We offer fast, discreet shipping across the U.S. and internationally, subject to local regulations.
  • Partnership Opportunities: Open to collaborations with retailers, influencers, and wellness advocates.
  • Customer Support: A dedicated team ensures customer satisfaction through personalized assistance and prompt responses.
  • Compliance: Products adhere to local and international safety and regulatory standards, ensuring consistent quality and reliability.

NUUD Pleasures Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Welcome to the Nuud Affiliate Program (the “Program”). By joining and participating in the Program, you agree to the following Terms and Conditions. Please read them carefully.

1. Eligibility

To participate in the Program, you must:

  • Be at least 18 years old.

  • Have a valid and active website, blog, or social media platform.

  • Agree to and comply with these Terms and Conditions.

2. Commission Structure

  • Affiliates earn a 20% commission on qualifying sales generated through their unique affiliate links.

  • Commissions are calculated after the 10% discount applied to the customer’s purchase.

  • Commission is paid on the net amount after discounts, taxes, shipping, and other applicable fees.

3. Payout Schedule

  • Commissions are paid out 30 days after the end of the month in which the sale occurred.

  • Payments are made via the payment method specified in your affiliate account.

  • Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment details. Nuud is not liable for payments sent to incorrect details due to affiliate errors.

4. Returns and Cancellations

  • No commission will be paid on sales that are refunded, canceled, or charged back.

  • If a sale initially qualifies for a commission but is later refunded or canceled, the commission for that sale will be deducted from your account.

5. Affiliate Discount Code

  • Affiliates are provided with a unique discount code to offer their audience 10% off on purchases.

  • Commissions are only earned on sales where the affiliate’s unique link or code is used.

6. Marketing and Promotion

  • Affiliates are encouraged to promote Nuud products ethically and in compliance with all applicable laws and regulations.

  • Prohibited activities include, but are not limited to:

    • Spamming (email or social media).

    • Misrepresenting Nuud products or making false claims.

    • Using paid search or bidding on branded keywords without prior approval.

  • Nuud reserves the right to terminate affiliates who engage in prohibited activities.

7. Affiliate Responsibilities

  • Affiliates are responsible for ensuring their unique links and codes are used correctly.

  • Affiliates are responsible for any taxes or reporting obligations related to earnings from the Program.

8. Termination

  • Nuud reserves the right to terminate an affiliate’s participation in the Program at any time for any reason, including but not limited to:

    • Breach of these Terms and Conditions.

    • Engaging in unethical or prohibited promotional activities.

    • Inactivity or lack of performance.

9. Modification of Terms

  • Nuud reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions at any time. Affiliates will be notified of changes via email or through the affiliate portal.

  • Continued participation in the Program after any modifications constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms and Conditions.

10. Limitation of Liability

  • Nuud is not liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages (including loss of revenue or commissions) arising from participation in the Program.

  • Nuud makes no representation that the operation of the Program will be uninterrupted or error-free.

11. Governing Law

  • These Terms and Conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of [Your Jurisdiction]. Any disputes arising from the Program shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in [Your Jurisdiction].

By joining the Nuud Affiliate Program, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to these Terms and Conditions.
